data_sources.occupancy_note: Our forward occupancy counts Booked nights only (PriceLabs booking_status); blocked nights are reported separately. PriceLabs market occupancy comes from scraped calendars and may count other hosts' blocked nights, so MPI is conservative. Last-30 occupancy/ADR/RevPAR come from Smoobu bookings (basePrice, before cleaning and commission) and exist only for properties mapped to a Smoobu apartment.
